correctness.rationale: The signed quadratic form has a definite matrix case reducible to convexity, an indefinite conic phase controlled by the displaced discriminant, and a null-line rigidity obstruction. Algebra and normalization were re-derived from first principles for all real SPD inputs. Critical cone-boundary argument, sign of q at each site, completed square, two hyperbolic branch cases, and Haar angular measure are explicit in RESULT.md. Reproducibility script checks exact special cases and angular discretization.

value.rationale: This complete, motivated two-site structural classification identifies the precise metric obstruction to simultaneous site-star-shapedness and, in the incomparable case, proves a generic one-orphan phenomenon with exact spectral angular probability and an exceptional-line transition. The probability is an invariant of the metric pair and independent of separation; it informs the domain of applicability of radial contact-function geometric tensor formulas.
